[P2] Revisit the untested initialization branch

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” is not satisfied here. No accompanying test exercises initialization with an unset or blank log-group variable; the cloud scenario supplies the variable, and the reported manual run exercises the handler body. Removing this guard therefore leaves those checks unchanged, allowing the missing-configuration protection to regress undetected. The change also lacks the required related unit tests. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and establish which validation branches are necessary and how tests demonstrate their necessity.
